children.text: TrainZilla India - Your privacy and data security is our top priority
Last updated: January 15, 2025 | Effective Date: January 15, 2025

TrainZilla India ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use our fitness platform and services in compliance with Indian laws including the Information Technology Act, 2000 and Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011.
By using TrainZilla services, you consent to the collection and use of your information as described in this policy.
Name, email address, phone number, and profile information
Business information including GST number and PAN details
Fitness and health data shared voluntarily
App usage patterns and feature interactions
Client fitness data and progress information
Providing access to TrainZilla platform and features
Enabling video calls and communication features
Generating AI-powered workout and nutrition plans
Improving our AI algorithms and recommendations
Customizing content for Indian market preferences
Analyzing usage patterns to enhance user experience
Complying with Indian legal and regulatory requirements
Preventing fraud and ensuring platform security
Resolving disputes and enforcing our terms
In compliance with Indian data protection laws, all sensitive personal data of Indian users is stored within India on secure servers. We use AWS India data centers located in Mumbai and Hyderabad.
256-bit SSL encryption for all data transmission
Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
Role-based access controls for our team members
Automated backup and disaster recovery systems

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations. Account information is retained for 7 years after account closure as per Indian financial regulations. You can request data deletion subject to our legal obligations.
We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share your information in the following circumstances:
Payment processors (Razorpay, Paytm) for transaction processing
Communication service providers for SMS and email
Compliance with court orders and legal processes
Protection of our rights and property
Prevention of fraud and illegal activities
In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred to the new entity, subject to the same privacy protections.
Access and download your personal information
Delete your account and associated data
Object to processing of your information
Choose your preferred language for communications
To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below. We will respond to your request within 30 days as required by Indian law.
We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience on our platform:
Required for platform functionality and security
Help us understand how users interact with our platform
You can control cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling certain cookies may affect platform functionality.
While we primarily store data in India, some data may be transferred internationally for:
Integration with international fitness tracking devices
All international transfers comply with Indian data protection laws and include appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses and adequacy decisions.

TrainZilla is not intended for individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.
If we discover that we have collected personal information from a child under 18, we will delete such information promptly.
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of any material changes by:
Email notification to your registered email address
In-app notification upon your next login
Continued use of our services after the effective date of changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
This Privacy Policy is governed by Indian law and any disputes will be resolved in Indian courts.
